plain_statement.zh: 证明边长 4.661 时不存在总权重小于 17q、且在每个可行开单位正方形中权重至少为 q 的有理点集（q 为正整数）。
plain_statement.en: At side 4.661, rule out weighted rational sites of total weight below 17q that hit every admissible open unit square to weight at least q, for positive integer q.

brief.zh: 证书给出 758 个对称轨道，方块总重 W=1361594240。用整数区间算术证明每个点上的覆盖权重至多 C=80071857，核对严格内部与容器边界。对方块和见证点双计数得 qW ≤ C∑w，而 W−17C=372671。将证书数据、全域容量证明与冻结命题接入 Lean。
brief.en: Expand the 758 symmetry orbits to weighted squares of total mass W=1361594240. Certify their pointwise depth bound C=80071857 on the whole container by integer interval arithmetic, respecting open interiors. Double counting gives qW ≤ C∑w, while W−17C=372671. Formalize the data, geometric coverage, and contradiction in Lean.
